summary: Information Security Analyst/Systems professional with over 16 years of diverse experience across analysis, troubleshooting, management and testing of complex IT systems, including cyber security, intrusion detection, system administration, and military cyber operations.

experience.title: Information Technology Specialist
responsibilities: Provide electronic surveillance of information systems and perform digital evidence analysis (DEA).
Offer technical analytical support to computer surveillance activities.
Conduct traffic analysis against adversary tactics, techniques, and protocols.
Configure and install routers, switches, and wireless controllers.
Draft training materials and organize training sessions for 6 employees.

experience.title: Network Security Analyst
responsibilities: Analyzed software, hardware, and network systems for various transmission systems.
Identified, reported, and resolved network security violations.

experience.title: Corporate Security
responsibilities: Ensured compliance with PCI, HIPAA, ISO 27001, and Sarbanes‑Oxley standards.
Responded to client technical support requests via phone and email.

experience.title: Network Security Analyst
responsibilities: Identified and responded to threats against Air Force worldwide computer networks on unclassified and classified entities (NIPR and SIPR).
Provided immediate analysis and verification of network activity using ASIM and Cisco IDS.
Detected network intrusions and applied countermeasures.
Analyzed trends of all network activity and provided daily activity reports to management and headquarters.
